purpose: ADR-070, the case Codex left unchecked in its review of #313 and #314: a conversation about two people that goes past the eight messages of one topic, with the real plan and answer model. Owner 03.10.2026: one run, at most 0.06 USD at the plan's prices, no repeat and no development in this task. Written and merged before the run. Run with --auto-modes, as the chat sends. The first message is a lone greeting: it is an ordinary saved turn of the topic (ADR-067) and costs about 0.001 USD, so eight messages fill the topic and the ninth crosses the boundary within the cost limit (a full turn cost 0.0056-0.0081 USD in the runs of 02.10; nine turns here are expected to cost about 0.055 USD). There is no room for a tenth message, so what the answer does with the father's amount after the boundary is not asked: that his amount is kept is read from the saved state, which the next answer is built from.

expected_facts.ema: lives in Kose vald; pension 600 euros (message 2), corrected to 700 euros after the boundary (message 9); cannot manage alone at home
expected_facts.isa: lives in Harku vald; pension 450 euros (message 4), never changed; has debts
expected_facts.focus: mother (2-3), father (4-5), mother (6), father (7-8), mother (9, the correction)
expected_facts.boundary: messages 1-8 are the first topic's eight; message 9 is sent as an ordinary follow-up and begins the topic that continues it
expected_facts.after_the_boundary: mother: 700 current and 600 superseded, Kose vald; father: 450 current, Harku vald; no fact of one person holds the other's amount

expectation_help.region: the municipality whose catalogue the turn's search used: the person the message is about
expectation_help.person_regions: the saved state's municipality of that person
expectation_help.facts_present / facts_absent / fact_chan: a current fact of the person whose quote matches / no such current fact / a fact that has become superseded
expectation_help.state_kept: the model's new state was not rejected
expectation_help.must_not on messages 5-7: an answer about one parent does not name the other parent's municipality or give the other's pension as theirs
expectation_help.person and plan_queries_must_not on the: the search plan (ADR-072): it read the message as the mother's, the person the corrected fact belongs to, and none of its queries asks the answered question about the father's application again (a deadline, a procedure, a decision) or is about his subject (the subsistence benefit, debts). The second check also fails a search made in the right municipality for the wrong subject
expectation_help.must on the correction: the answer's first sentence names the corrected amount (the dialogue instruction's rule for a correction)
expectation_help.must_not on the correction: a message that only corrects an amount is not answered with anything else (ADR-071): the answer does not ask again where the mother lives, give one parent's amount as the other's, solve the answered question about the father's application again (a deadline), say that an earlier statement cannot be confirmed, or ask whose application is meant

scenarios.title: Ema ja isa, eri summad, parandus pärast kaheksandat sõnumit

turns.text: Minu ema elab Kose vallas ja tema pension on 600 eurot. Ta ei saa enam üksi kodus hakkama.
Milliseid teenuseid vald talle pakkuda saab?
Minu isa elab Harku vallas ja tema pension on 450 eurot. Tal on võlad ja ta ei tule rahaga toime.
turns.note: The focus moves to the father; the mother's facts stay hers.

turns.text: Kuhu ta saab oma vallas pöörduda?
Tagasi ema juurde: kas ta peab hooldekodu koha eest ise maksma?
turns.note: The focus moves back to the mother.

turns.text: Ja kas isa võib taotleda toimetulekutoetust?
turns.note: The focus moves to the father again.

turns.text: Kui kiiresti vald tema taotluse üle otsustab?
turns.note: The eighth message: the topic is full after it. Its state is what the next topic is handed.

turns.text: Vabandust, ema pension on hoopis 700 eurot.
turns.note: The ninth message, across the boundary: a correction of the mother's amount while the father was in focus. The mother's 600 becomes superseded and 700 current; the father's 450 stays current and his; both keep their municipalities.
